## Change

Describe the user/developer outcome and the meaningful implementation changes.

## Evidence

List the checks actually performed and any unverified assumptions or environment limitations.

## Documentation impact

List updated canonical pages and diagrams, or explain why the change does not affect documentation.
See the change-to-document map in `docs/MAINTAINING-DOCS.md`.

- [ ] User/API behavior, developer guidance, and product scope agree with the change.
- [ ] Affected flow diagrams, architecture images, and security limitations are current.
- [ ] Links, examples, and changed visuals are reviewed; no secrets or private workload data are included.
